description: This script analyzes documentation files (Markdown or MDX) in a project to identify glossary terms and check for missing internationalization entries related to those terms. It interacts with Git to compare different branches or commits, reads glossary definitions from a JSON file, and extracts terminology used in documentation to ensure proper translation coverage.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for base and head git references.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command synchronously and returns its trimmed output.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Determines the common merge base for comparison, with fallback options.

methods.name: listChangedDocs
methods.description: Lists documentation files that have changed between two git references.

methods.name: loadGlossarySources
methods.description: Loads and parses the glossary source terms from a JSON file.

methods.name: containsLatin
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any Latin alphabet characters.

methods.name: wordCount
methods.description: Counts the number of words in a string.

methods.name: unquoteScalar
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a scalar value string.

methods.name: isGlossaryCandidate
methods.description: Determines if a term is a valid glossary candidate based on specific criteria.

methods.name: readGitFile
methods.description: Reads a file's contents at a specific git commit or branch.

methods.name: extractTerms
methods.description: Extracts glossary terms from documentation content, identifying titles and link labels.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function orchestrating the analysis workflow.
